ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain The National and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain School rules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Class Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
